svg.text: French AZERTY • Thumb taps ON • Home-row mods ON • macOS OFF
Three views of the same physical keys. Smaller labels show the action when held.
Tap actions + hold modifiers. Central Escape, Backspace and Enter are disabled; Delete stays active.
Hold right Space · orange keys are Navigation actions; grey keys retain their typing action.
Hold AltGr · purple keys are Symbols actions; grey keys retain their typing action.
Hold timing: Space / AltGr / home-row mods 300 ms · Esc, Tab, Enter and PrtScr thumb modifiers 150 ms.
Shift and AltGr tap as one-shot modifiers. Numpad decimal follows the host settings. Diagram reflects config/qmx2040.keymap.
